# Trump’s approval drops 2 points in 2 weeks: Reuters/Ipsos poll

by Max Rego - 08/17/26 4:56 PM ET

Link copied

One-third of Americans approve of President Trump’s job performance, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos survey.

The poll, conducted from Friday through Monday, found that 33 percent of 1,166 respondents approved of the job Trump is doing, while 64 percent disapproved. The poll had a margin of error of 3 percentage points. [...] The president’s approval rating, as measured by Reuters and Ipsos, is down 2 percentage points from a survey the polling partners released Aug. 3. July 28, 2026

Americans' approval of Donald Trump's job performance continues to decline, according to the July 25 - 27 Economist / YouGov Poll. 34% of U.S. adult citizens strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, tied for a record low for either Trump term, while a record 62% disapprove. That's a net job approval of -28, also a record low.

At this point in Trump's first term, he had a net job approval of -9. [...] Among white Americans without college degrees, 43% approve of Trump and 52% disapprove.
